verdict.rationale: Solo 2 has a developer ecosystem (CLI commands, firmware build docs), so an interactive API reference is a fair question, but the evidence shows no such reference or runnable examples. Probes of OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.solokeys.dev all returned 404, and the docs consist of static build and CLI instructions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
